items.headline: Live results, best moments and analysis from Seahawks-Patriots
items.description: The 2026 NFL season opens with a rematch between last year's Super Bowl teams, the Seattle Seahawks and the New England Patriots. Here are all the highlights from the first game of the new season.

items.headline: Seahawks QB Darnold (hip) out after opening drive vs. Patriots
items.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold has been ruled out of the season opener against the Patriots after suffering a hip injury on the opening drive.

items.headline: Seahawks down two safeties with Emmanwori (ankle) ruled out for opener
items.description: The Seahawks, already without Ty Okada for Wednesday's opener against the Patriots, also ruled out safety Nick Emmanwori, who is working his way back from ankle surgery.

items.headline: Khosla family seeks to empower Seahawks leaders to make decisions
items.description: As the Khosla family takes over the Super Bowl champion Seahawks, the approach of the franchise's new controlling owners will be to not mess with a good thing.

items.headline: NFL Week 1 uniforms: Vikings rocking throwbacks, Bengals go orange
items.description: The NFL is back, and so are the uniform combinations. Here's a look at what each team is wearing in Week 1.
